chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Statement of Allah the Exalted: 'And when a man is touched by harm, he calls upon his Lord turning to Him.' He said: 'It was revealed regarding Abu al-Faseel, for he used to consider the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) a sorcerer. So when harm touched him, meaning illness, he would call upon his Lord turning to Him, meaning repenting to Him from what he used to say regarding the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Then when He grants him a favor from Him, meaning health, he forgets what he used to call upon Him for before, meaning he forgets the repentance to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, from what he used to say regarding the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he was a sorcerer. And therefore Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Say: Enjoy yourself in your unbelief for a little, surely you are of the companions of the Fire,' meaning your rule over the people without right from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and from His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family).'

He said: Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, turned the statement regarding Ali (peace be upon him), informing of his state and merit in the presence of Allah, Blessed and Exalted. So He said: 'What! is he who is obedient during the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord? Say: Are those who know that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and those who do not know (saying) that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and that he is a lying sorcerer alike? Only those of understanding take heed.'
He said: Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'This is its interpretation, O Ammar.'

key_terms.أَبُو الْفَصِيلِ: Abu al-Faseel, a companion known for his view of the Prophet as a sorcerer before his death

ai.seo_question: What is the tafsir of Surah Az-Zumar verse 8 regarding Abu al-Faseel and its connection to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that the verse 'And when a man is touched by harm...' was revealed regarding Abu al-Faseel, a sorcerer who viewed the Prophet as a magician; his pattern of repenting during affliction but forgetting it upon recovery illustrates the concept of 'Enjoy your unbelief for a little.' The Imam then shifts focus to the subsequent verses praising Ali (peace be upon him), interpreting the contrast between those who know and those who do not as a divine affirmation of Ali's spiritual station and the superiority of true knowledge over superficial belief.

en.hubeali: H 14694 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al-Hassan Bin Mahboub, from hashaam Bin Saalim, from Ammaar Al-saabaty who said:

I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Statement of Allahazwj the High: “[39:8] And when distress afflicts a man he calls upon his Lord turning to Him frequently”, heasws said: ‘This was Revealed regarding Abu Al-Faseyl, who used to consider the Rasool Allahsaww as a sorcerer. And when distress afflicted him, meaning illness, he would call upon his Lordazwj, turning to Himazwj frequently, meaning penitently to Himazwj, from what he used to say with regards to the Rasool Allahsaww. “then when He makes him possess a favour from Him,” meaning the restoration of health, “he forgets that for which he called upon Him before,” meaning his asking for Forgiveness to Allahazwj from what he used to say regarding the Rasool Allahsaww that hesaww was a sorcerer, and that is the Statement of Allahazwj mighty and Majestic “Say: Enjoy yourself in your ungratefulness a little, surely you are of the inmates of the fire”, meaning your influence which you have over the people with any right from Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic or from Hisazwj Messengersaww’.

He (the narrator) said: ‘Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Then Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Spoke Sympathetically with regards to Aliasws Informing himasws of hisasws situation, and hisasws merits in the Presence of Allahazwj Blessed and High. So Heazwj Said: “[39:9] What! he who is obedient during hours of the night, prostrating himself and standing, takes care of the hereafter and hopes for the mercy of his Lord! Say: Are those who know that Muhammad is the Rasool Allahsaww, and those who do not know (saying) that Muhammadsaww is a lying sorcerer alike? Only the men of understanding are mindful”.
Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is its explanation, O Ammar’.
